name: Milan junior marketer seeking paid entry work

context.seniority: Junior; first permanent job or paid internship
context.employment_state: Seeking an initial stable role; limited budget
constraints: Wants digital marketing rather than a sales-only job
Budget-sensitive; reluctant to buy job-search subscriptions
context.company_awareness: Low; recognises some brands but has no fixed target list

trigger: A promising marketing interview turns out to concern commission-based promotion, prompting more specific searches for paid digital work.

searches_run.query: lavoro marketing junior Milano stage retribuito
searches_run.observation: Results included paid internships with variable duties, employer postings and aggregators. An opened uCV result was explicitly closed despite appearing in retrieval; its duties included reception and workspace operations alongside digital marketing.

searches_run.query: stage digital marketing Ticino retribuito no vendita
searches_run.observation: The sample included an older Ticino Turismo internship PDF, institutional documents and discussions; it did not establish a suitable current paid digital-marketing opening in Ticino.

sources.title: Junior Marketing Specialist — Cofoundry on uCV
sources.supports: Directly inspected aggregator page marks the role closed and lists paid internship, operations, reception and digital marketing duties. This supports duty ambiguity, not a claim that the employer is deceptive.

sources.title: Social Media Manager - stage curriculare — Publicis Groupe
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet includes student eligibility and a monthly expense allowance. Direct access returned 403, so current availability was not verified.

sources.title: Stagista Settore Mercato CH — Ticino Turismo
sources.supports: An older employer internship PDF appeared for the Ticino query. Retrieval alone does not show a current vacancy or pay.

best_entry_page.promise: Find junior marketing openings and compare stated duties, internship requirements and published compensation before applying.
best_entry_page.cta: Try free junior-marketing searches and save alerts for relevant employers.
proof_needed: Current, covered employers with paid entry-level examples.
Distinguish stated pay, missing pay and expense allowances without annualising ambiguously.
Show actual digital duties instead of claiming to certify honest employers.
Explain curricular/student requirements when stated; this persona's enrolment status is unknown.
Keep free search and alerts prominent; advanced description checking is optional Pro.
An indexable Italian guide must be newly created.

conversion_objections: Why pay when I do not yet have a salary?
Will I mostly see unpaid or commission-based work?
Is a stage open to people no longer enrolled?
Do you cover Italian and Ticino employers beyond technology startups?
Will a paid label reveal the actual amount?

avoid_targeting.reason: An internship cannot guarantee permanent employment.
Job-description screening is not employer verification and cannot certify or accuse companies.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Voglio imparare campagne e contenuti, non scoprire al colloquio che il lavoro è solo vendita. Se mi fate vedere mansioni e compenso quando sono pubblicati, provo gli avvisi gratuiti; per ora non ho budget per un abbonamento.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic Italian searcher. Two queries, two failed source opens and one successful aggregator inspection; no hiring-market quantities or fraud conclusions inferred. Ticino evidence was weak in this small retrieval sample, not evidence of no opportunities.

search_journey.fit_reason: Role, experience and location search fit.
Broad discovery is useful before employer selection.
Employment type helps; payment still needs explicit evidence.
